summary: Include ~/.bashrc in the legacy cleanup set for uninstall, update the README list, and extend CANDIDATE_PROFILES/test_uninstall_clears_every_candidate_profile to cover it.
requirements: --uninstall omits ~/.bashrc, although the previous installer wrote the marked block there for bash when ~/.bashrc existed or when no ~/.bash_profile existed. Upgrading and uninstalling therefore leaves the old PATH block behind.
